description: Amelia Earhart's disappearance is one of the most enduring unsolved mysteries in history. On July 2, 1937, Earhart's Lockheed Electra 10E disappeared over the Pacific Ocean, and despite numerous theories, what really happened remains a mystery. Follow us for more true crime stories.
